about: Field definitions for ontology files (laid down by the system, read-only). Naming: X.json describes node X, and its children live in the sibling X/ directory; id must equal the file name. Nested concept directories mean is_a; nested entity directories mean part-of; relations can be flat or grouped in directories (grouping only). References use ids only, so moving directories never breaks them. Writes check a single file; cross-file problems such as broken references or type mismatches are flagged on the card and only block at promotion.

required.id: slug: starts with a lowercase letter; letters, digits, underscores; ≤40; equals the file name
required.label: the human-readable name
required.gloss: one-sentence gloss: what it refers to; for a measure (yield, conversion …) state its definition, that is, how it is computed

optional.kind: category (reactor, catalyst); measure (yield, impurity; needs unit); phenomenon (drift, deactivation)
optional.unit: unit (required for a measure; "1" if dimensionless)
optional.basis: basis: which material establishes this term
optional.replaced_by: the id that replaces it once deprecated

example.label: Joint-embedding predictive architecture
example.gloss: predicts the representation of a target from context in representation space, without reconstructing pixels

required.id: slug, as for concepts (concepts and relations share one id space)
required.label: the human-readable name
required.range: what the object is: a concept id (the object is an entity of that concept), or {"form": "statement" | "quantity" | "formula" | "code" | "reference", "unit"?: "..."} (the object is a literal value)

optional.kind: affects (how one quantity moves with another); defines (how a measure is computed); measures (which instrument reads which quantity); manifests_as (what a phenomenon looks like in the readings)
optional.shape: rough shape of an effect: increasing | decreasing | peak | threshold | coupled; expectations come from it
optional.check: for a measurement: how to check the reading (reference probe, standard, repeat point)
optional.domain: which concept the subject must be (subconcepts count)
optional.functional: true = single-valued: one value per subject; two different values are reported as a conflict

required.id: starts with a letter or digit; letters, digits, underscores, hyphens; ≤60; equals the file name
required.label: the human-readable name
required.type: which concept it is an entity of (concept id)
required.basis: basis: which material lets it be identified
required.provenance: source {"kind": "url" | "named" | "backref", "ref": "link / paper name / file in the workspace"}

optional.relations: its outgoing relations, each with a source: {"predicate": relation id, "object": another entity id} or {"predicate": relation id, "value": literal, "unit"?: unit}; both need "evidence": {"kind", "ref"}
